prompts.arrest: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single 16:9 full-screen memory tableau for Hooshang, a Persian narrative platformer, composed to read at 320x180. Detailed modern pixel art with watercolor-influenced soft gradient shading and crisp pixel edges, restrained painterly bleed, NOT 8-bit/NES. Dusk in an old Iranian plaster-and-brick alley, muted indigo, ochre and terracotta. Exactly two seventeen-year-old Iranian boys and one adult uniformed officer; the officer firmly holds Jamshid's upper arm as Jamshid turns back calmly toward his cousin. Jamshid: tousled black hair, thick eyebrows, warm tan skin, olive-green sleeveless vest, cream shirt, small rust neck detail, brown trousers. Hooshang: dark swept hair, brown jacket, white shirt, dark trousers, frozen helplessly a few steps away. Clearly adolescents with longer limbs, not small children. A small spray can lies on the ground beside a plain plaster wall. No weapons, no blood, no modern police logos. Wide restrained emotional composition; figures and story action contained in the upper 120/180 of frame, lower third quiet shadow for dialogue overlay. No text, letters, captions, borders, panel divisions or UI. Output one finished landscape illustration.
